subject: Maintainers Fellowship — trial credits and pairing request
messages:
From: Evelyn Baker <evelyn@openweave.org>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@openweave.org
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Maintainers Fellowship — trial credits and pairing request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the earlier coffee — OpenWeave is launching a small paid fellows program for active maintainers (we call it the Maintainers Fellowship). We have 10 fellows joining in June for a three-month program; most are small OSS teams without steady cloud budgets.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide trial credits (or compute voucher equivalents) so each fellow has enough runway to run model-backed demos during the program? We estimate ~75k tokens or a few hundred GPU minutes per fellow over three months.
- Would Redwood consider a paired mentoring promo (a matching promo credit if fellows try Redwood in their projects) and promotional placement on our community channels? That would help adoption and give Redwood visibility with a high-signal OSS audience.

Attached is a roster and a short program brief. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through details.

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Baker
Head of Programs, OpenWeave Collective
partners@openweave.org

Attachments:
- fellowship_roster.csv (csv list of fellows)
- program_brief.md (1 page)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Baker <evelyn@openweave.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Maintainers Fellowship — trial credits and pairing request

Hi Evelyn — great to hear about the fellowship, congrats on pulling it together.

Short answer: we can almost certainly help. A few quick clarifying questions so we surface the right approval path:
1) Is the ask 10 fellows x ~75k tokens each (or would you prefer a per-fellow GPU-minute allocation)? Either is fine but approvals differ slightly.
2) Do fellows need private deployments / VPC access, or will hosted API usage be sufficient for the pilot?
3) Will OpenWeave require a formal MSA/SOW for the promotional match, or is a simple promo code/HubSpot agreement okay?

Operational note: for a promotional match we typically do a pilot cohort (3–6 projects) first, then expand. If youre open to a staged approach we can fast-track a smaller allotment this month while Marissa and Karthik route the promotional package.

Ill attach a quick credits_request_form — if you can fill the per-fellow expected usage well estimate a gross allocation and run it past finance. Can we do a 20–30 minute sync Monday?

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments:
- credits_request_form.csv (fillable)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Maintainers Fellowship — trial credits and pairing request

Looping in approvals and a suggested cadence.

Soojin / Karthik — thanks for flagging. Operational suggestion based on similar community pilots:
- Stage 1 (fast-track): Approve 6 fellows for a 3-month hosted-api trial, 100k tokens equivalent each (covers prototype demos + a small inference integration), promotional match (50% match in credits if fellows publish a short case study or OpenWeave hosts a demo). This minimizes risk and gives us content.
- Stage 2 (expansion): If Stage 1 shows signal (>= 3 integrations launched or >10 demo sessions), expand to remaining fellows and consider a mentor stipend top-up (compute credit) or a small paid grant.

Compliance note: we should confirm PII/data handling expectations in the fellowship projects; if any fellows process regulated data we'll need the private deployment flow. Also request Evelyn to sign a short SOW so we have the promotional deliverables documented.

I'll approve the fast-track pilot from a sponsorship budget perspective once Soojin confirms final counts and we have the roster + filled credits form. Karthik — can you confirm budget/finance okay to allocate the 6x100k token trial by EOD Monday?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Developer Relations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: SOW_draft.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Baker <evelyn@openweave.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 14:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Maintainers Fellowship — trial credits and pairing request

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the quick turnaround and for filling the roster (received). Good news: we can commit to a fast-track pilot. Summary and next steps: 

What were approving now
- Fast-track pilot: 6 fellows approved for 100k-token hosted API credit each (approx compute/traffic for demos).
- Promotional match: Redwood will provide a 50% promo match (50k-token bonus per fellow) conditional on a short public write-up or a recorded demo session hosted by OpenWeave.

Conditions / Ask from OpenWeave
- Please confirm which 6 fellows should be included (email roster ids) by EOD Monday, 24 May.
- Sign the brief SOW (attached draft) that lists promotional deliverables — we can accept a signed DocuSign or a reply-agree to terms.
- Confirm none of the pilot projects require private hosting / special encryption; if they do, well route a private deployment discussion (different timeline).

Ops notes
- Karthik will provision the promo codes and the credits when we get the confirmed list.
- Expected grant activation: within 48 hours of roster confirmation + signed SOW.

Happy to hop on a quick call Monday morning if you want to go over the SOW.

Cheers,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments:
- SOW_draft.pdf
- fellowship_roster.csv (confirmed 6-of-10 highlighted)
